name: Clicker V
source:
The creature, the forest, the hole. 

Where did you come from? Why are you here? All answers are one click away.

Click, click, click... The mystery only deepens the further you go down the rabbits hole.

[From [url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/clicker-v]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
生物、森林、洞穴。

你从哪里来？你为什么在这里？所有答案只需一键点击即可获得。

点击、点击、点击……越深入兔子洞，谜团就越深。

[来自[url=https://studio-lemi.itch.io/clicker-v]Itch.io[/url]]
